Use

  • One clear primary action per decision.
  • Sage for a genuine educational recommendation.
  • Persistent error with a relevant recovery action.
  • Visible text alongside progress and status color.

Avoid

  • Pale Sage text on white or white text on pale Sage.
  • Using success green for every selected filter.
  • Buttons nested inside a whole-card button/link.
  • Critical errors only in disappearing notifications.
  • Fake retry controls or fabricated achievements.
